  <item>
    <title><![CDATA[AIDE²: The First Evidence of Recursive Self-Improvement]]></title>
    <link>https://www.weco.ai/blog/first-evidence-of-recursive-self-improvement</link>
    <guid>https://www.weco.ai/blog/first-evidence-of-recursive-self-improvement</guid>
    <pubDate>Tue, 14 Jul 2026 00:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
    <description><![CDATA[We ran autoresearch on autoresearch: an outer loop rewriting its own research agent for 100 unattended steps. In eight days it discovered agents that beat our two years of hand-tuning on held-out benchmarks, and taught itself to reward hack less.]]></description>
    <enclosure url="https://www.weco.ai/assets/blogs/first-evidence-of-recursive-self-improvement/cover.png" type="image/jpeg" />
    <author>Dhruv Srikanth</author><author>Bingchen Zhao</author><author>Dixing Xu</author><author>Yuxiang Wu</author><author>Zhengyao Jiang</author>
  </item>
  
  <item>
    <title><![CDATA[4 Levels of Recursive Self-Improvement]]></title>
    <link>https://www.weco.ai/blog/4-levels-of-recursive-self-improvement</link>
    <guid>https://www.weco.ai/blog/4-levels-of-recursive-self-improvement</guid>
    <pubDate>Fri, 10 Jul 2026 00:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
    <description><![CDATA[RSI is usually discussed as a binary. We grade it instead: four levels — delegation, net positive, ignition, inflection — each the necessary condition for the next, and precise enough to be falsifiable.]]></description>
    <enclosure url="https://www.weco.ai/blog_covers/rsi-levels-ladder.png" type="image/jpeg" />
    <author>Weco Team</author>
  </item>

  <item>
    <title><![CDATA[SpecBench: Measuring Reward Hacking in Long-Horizon Coding Agents]]></title>
    <link>https://www.weco.ai/blog/specbench</link>
    <guid>https://www.weco.ai/blog/specbench</guid>
    <pubDate>Thu, 21 May 2026 00:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
    <description><![CDATA[We built SpecBench to measure the gap between code that passes visible tests and code that actually satisfies the specification. Across 30 systems-level tasks, that gap is real, measurable, and grows with task complexity.]]></description>
    <enclosure url="https://www.weco.ai/assets/blogs/specbench/cover.png" type="image/jpeg" />
    <author>Bingchen Zhao</author><author>Dhruv Srikanth</author><author>Yuxiang Wu</author><author>Zhengyao Jiang</author>
  </item>

    <title><![CDATA[Evolving a Flappy Bird AI: 100 Solutions Explored, 6.6x Improvement, $12]]></title>

    <guid>https://www.weco.ai/blog/flappy-bird-case-study</guid>
